title: HeavenzFire Guardian Anti-Manipulation Rubric
status: proposed evaluation rubric; not a validated detector
purpose: Identify potentially manipulative gambling-interface patterns from user-provided screenshots, OCR text, or publicly accessible page text so people can understand risks and choose protective actions.

allowed_inputs: publicly accessible pages reviewed without authentication bypass
excluded_actions: logging into or scraping private accounts
profiling named individuals or inferring sensitive personal traits

principles: Record uncertainty and plausible benign explanations
Human review before publishing accusations or escalating reports
Prefer user protection, accessibility, informed choice, and reversibility

deterministic_patterns.pattern: (?i)(you lost.{0,50}(deposit|wager|bet)|deposit now to win it back|win it back|recover your losses|chase your losses)
deterministic_patterns.rationale: The text explicitly links further play or deposit to recovering losses.
The text contains explicit urgency or countdown language.

deterministic_patterns.pattern: (?i)(near miss|almost won|so close to winning|just missed the jackpot)
deterministic_patterns.rationale: The text explicitly frames an outcome as nearly winning.
The text references automatic repeated play; default state and stop friction require more context.

deterministic_patterns.pattern: (?i)(players like you|others are winning|everyone is playing|recent winners|your friends won)
deterministic_patterns.rationale: The text invokes other users or winners as a possible participation nudge.
The text explicitly links a protective control with an obstruction or difficulty.

deterministic_patterns.pattern: (?i)(because you lost|we noticed you lost|based on your recent losses|your recent play|your last losses)
deterministic_patterns.rationale: The text explicitly references a person's recent play or losses in promotional context.

signals.label: Near-miss or almost-won framing
indicators: UI text emphasizes how close a loss was to a win
Repeated celebratory effects appear after a losing outcome
counter_indicators: Neutral outcome reporting
A clear educational explanation that a near miss is still a loss
evidence_required: Exact visible text or screenshot region
Context establishing whether the round was a loss
protective_mitigations: Use neutral outcome labels
Offer optional reduced-stimulation display
Avoid presenting losses as progress toward a win

signals.label: Loss-chasing nudge
indicators: A prompt urges another deposit or wager after a loss
Copy frames continued play as a way to recover losses
counter_indicators: A cooling-off prompt
A neutral exit or session-summary option
evidence_required: Exact prompt text
Visible sequence or context linking the prompt to a loss
protective_mitigations: Provide a clear stop or exit path
Offer time-outs and deposit limits
Avoid recovery claims or urgency after losses

signals.label: Artificial urgency or scarcity
indicators: Countdowns or expiring offers pressure immediate action
Urgency is repeated without a verifiable reason
counter_indicators: A real, clearly explained deadline
An option to dismiss without penalty
evidence_required: Visible countdown or urgency copy
Any available context about the stated deadline
protective_mitigations: Remove unnecessary countdowns
State material terms before commitment
Allow review without time pressure

signals.label: Deposit and withdrawal friction asymmetry
indicators: Deposits are prominent while withdrawal controls are difficult to find
Withdrawal requires materially more steps than deposit in the observed flow
counter_indicators: Clearly explained, proportionate identity or fraud-prevention checks
A visible withdrawal route with transparent requirements
evidence_required: Screenshots or notes for each observed step
A comparable deposit and withdrawal path
No inference from a single screen when the rest of the flow is unknown
protective_mitigations: Make withdrawal controls discoverable
Explain delays and requirements before submission
Avoid dark-pattern confirmation loops

signals.label: Material offer terms are obscured
indicators: Important restrictions are visually de-emphasized
Wagering requirements or expiry terms appear only after a commitment step
counter_indicators: Prominent, plain-language terms before acceptance
A clear cost and restriction summary
evidence_required: Offer headline and nearby terms
Visible hierarchy or sequence showing when terms appear
protective_mitigations: Present material restrictions before acceptance
Use plain language and accessible contrast
Provide a side-by-side cost and obligation summary

signals.label: Autoplay or frictionless repeated play
indicators: Repeated play is enabled by default
Stopping or changing limits requires more friction than continuing
counter_indicators: Autoplay disabled by default
Persistent stop controls and clear session boundaries
evidence_required: Visible default state
Observed controls for continuing and stopping
protective_mitigations: Disable autoplay by default
Provide a persistent stop control
Add optional session reminders and time-outs

signals.label: Social proof or notification pressure
indicators: Repeated prompts emphasize other users' wins or activity to spur participation
Notifications interrupt or pressure return to play
counter_indicators: Optional, quiet, user-controlled notifications
Balanced information that does not imply likely personal success
evidence_required: Exact notification or social-proof text
Whether the display is optional or repeated
protective_mitigations: Make promotional notifications opt-in
Offer quiet hours and one-step disabling
Avoid implying that others' outcomes predict the user's outcome

signals.label: Cooling-off or self-exclusion obstruction
indicators: Self-exclusion is difficult to locate compared with play controls
A cooling-off request triggers repeated persuasion to continue
counter_indicators: A clear, accessible self-exclusion route
A neutral confirmation with transparent consequences
evidence_required: Observed path to self-exclusion or time-out
Exact copy shown during the request
protective_mitigations: Provide a direct, accessible route
Honor the request without persuasion loops
Explain duration and reactivation rules plainly

signals.label: Potential exposure of minors
indicators: Gambling promotion appears in content clearly intended for minors
Age safeguards are absent from an observed access path
counter_indicators: A robust age gate with an appropriate fallback
No evidence that the content or audience is directed at minors
evidence_required: Publicly observable placement and context
Do not identify or collect data about individual children
protective_mitigations: Age-appropriate access controls
Responsible reporting to the relevant platform or regulator
Minimize collection of any child-related information

signals.label: Potentially targeted promotional pressure
indicators: Visible copy explicitly references recent losses or play frequency to encourage more play
A public offer explicitly conditions pressure messaging on recent behavior
counter_indicators: Generic promotion without evidence of personal targeting
User-controlled personalization and clear opt-outs
evidence_required: Exact visible text or publicly documented behavior
Do not infer a hidden algorithm from appearance alone
protective_mitigations: Offer a clear opt-out from promotional personalization
Avoid targeting people at moments of apparent vulnerability
Use independent audits and documented governance

risk_levels.meaning: A pattern may be present but evidence is incomplete or harm is unclear.
A minor concern with a plausible benign explanation; monitor or improve clarity.
A concrete interface pattern may pressure decisions or obscure material information.
Evidence suggests meaningful friction against stopping, withdrawing, or understanding obligations.
Strong, reviewed evidence indicates severe obstruction of protective controls or a serious risk to vulnerable users.

decision_rules: A screenshot or model response alone does not prove intent, illegality, or the behavior of a hidden ranking or recommendation algorithm.
Quote or locate the exact evidence for every flagged signal.
Report observed facts separately from inferred mechanisms.
Record at least one plausible counter-explanation and what evidence would resolve it.
Do not publish allegations or trigger automated external actions without human review.
Prefer local processing and redact personal identifiers before storing or sharing evidence.
validation_plan: Create a human-labeled evaluation set with consent and privacy review.
Measure precision, recall, false-positive rate, and reviewer agreement per signal.
Test across screen sizes, accessibility settings, languages, and benign comparison interfaces.
Require regression tests before changing the rubric or model prompts.
limitations: This rubric is a proposed engineering instrument, not a validated clinical or legal assessment.
It cannot infer a hidden algorithm from a screenshot alone.
It does not diagnose gambling disorder or replace professional support.
Model agreement is not independent ground truth.
